diff --git a/opensiddur/exporter/tex/reledmac.xslt b/opensiddur/exporter/tex/reledmac.xslt
index cbb6f39..d6a28b8 100644
--- a/opensiddur/exporter/tex/reledmac.xslt
+++ b/opensiddur/exporter/tex/reledmac.xslt
@@ -328,6 +328,15 @@
              \OSKeepSep draws its strut as a rule of its own: \strut copies \strutbox,
              and a copy keeps the attributes it was made with, which are none. -->
         <xsl:text>\newattribute\OSKeepAttr
</xsl:text>
+        <!-- Apparatus insertion starts its paragraph before expanding the note.
+             Read our direction tag from the third normalfootfmt argument before
+             noindent creates that paragraph; leave untagged apparatus unchanged. -->
+        <xsl:text>\protected\def\OSNoteDirection#1{\pardir#1\textdir#1}
</xsl:text>
+        <xsl:text>\makeatletter
\long\def\OSInspectNoteDirection#1#2#3{\OSPeekNoteDirection#3\OSNoteDirectionEnd}
</xsl:text>
+        <xsl:text>\def\OSPeekNoteDirection{\@ifnextchar\OSNoteDirection{\OSReadNoteDirection}{\OSSkipNoteDirection}}
</xsl:text>
+        <xsl:text>\long\def\OSReadNoteDirection\OSNoteDirection#1#2\OSNoteDirectionEnd{\OSNoteDirection{#1}}
</xsl:text>
+        <xsl:text>\long\def\OSSkipNoteDirection#1\OSNoteDirectionEnd{}
</xsl:text>
+        <xsl:text>\pretocmd{\normalvfootnote@inserted}{\OSInspectNoteDirection#2}{}{\PackageError{opensiddur}{could not set apparatus paragraph direction}{}}
\makeatother
</xsl:text>
         <xsl:text>\newcommand{\OSKeepHeadBegin}{\OSKeepAttr=1\relax}
</xsl:text>
         <xsl:text>\newcommand{\OSKeepHeadEnd}{\unsetattribute\OSKeepAttr}
</xsl:text>
         <xsl:text>\newcommand{\OSKeepSep}{\mbox{\OSKeepAttr=2\relax\vrule width 0pt height\ht\strutbox depth\dp\strutbox}}
</xsl:text>
@@ -1073,7 +1082,7 @@
                          reledmac zeroes \parfillskip inside a \pstart, which is why a
                          heading set in a column looks right and this one, set between
                          columns, did not. -->
-                    <xsl:text>{\parfillskip=0pt\interlinepenalty=10000\relax </xsl:text>
+                    <xsl:text>\par
{\parfillskip=0pt\interlinepenalty=10000\relax </xsl:text>
                     <xsl:if test="$is-hebrew">
                         <xsl:text>\begin{hebrew}</xsl:text>
                     </xsl:if>
@@ -1081,7 +1090,7 @@
                          with this title. Its \nobreak goes after \begin{hebrew}, which
                          writes a language record to the page, and a skip after a \write
                          can break whatever penalty came before it. -->
-                    <xsl:text>\OSApplyKeep </xsl:text>
+                    <xsl:text>\par\OSApplyKeep\vskip0.5\baselineskip\relax\noindent </xsl:text>
                     <xsl:value-of select="$titles"/>
                     <xsl:if test="$is-hebrew">
                         <xsl:text>\end{hebrew}</xsl:text>
@@ -2484,6 +2493,10 @@ end
                                  excluded from line numbering. It is kept whole, however
                                  many lines its title and translation run to, and kept
                                  with the paragraph after it; see \OSKeepNext. -->
+                            <!-- This full-width heading is not the spanning-heading
+                                 path. End any language paragraph before adding its
+                                 separation, outside the numbered line's box. -->
+                            <xsl:text>\par\OSApplyKeep\vskip0.5\baselineskip\relax
</xsl:text>
                             <xsl:text>\begingroup\interlinepenalty=10000\relax
</xsl:text>
                             <xsl:call-template name="pstart"/><xsl:text>\skipnumbering
</xsl:text>
                             <xsl:call-template name="heading">
@@ -2619,9 +2632,15 @@ end
                             <xsl:if test="$in-pstart">
                                 <xsl:text>\pend
</xsl:text>
                             </xsl:if>
-                            <xsl:call-template name="pstart"/>
+                            <!-- Paired columns count paragraphs even when a side
+                                 is empty. A full-width stream has no such partner:
+                                 defer opening until actual content, so a chapter-only
+                                 fragment cannot consume a rubric's keep-with-next. -->
+                            <xsl:if test="$single-pstart">
+                                <xsl:call-template name="pstart"/>
+                            </xsl:if>
                             <xsl:next-iteration>
-                                <xsl:with-param name="in-pstart" select="true()"/>
+                                <xsl:with-param name="in-pstart" select="$single-pstart"/>
                             </xsl:next-iteration>
                         </xsl:otherwise>
                     </xsl:choose>
@@ -3863,6 +3882,13 @@ end
                             then f:is-inline-conditional($start)
                             else (ancestor::tei:p or ancestor::tei:l)">
                 <xsl:text>\OSCondEndInline{}</xsl:text>
+                <!-- The bracket macro trims the scope's final word space. Move
+                     that source boundary outside the bracket, without separating
+                     an attached prefix or adding another existing outer space. -->
+                <xsl:if test="matches(string(preceding-sibling::node()[1]), '\s$')
+                    and matches(string(following-sibling::node()[1]), '^[\p{L}\p{N}\p{Ps}]')">
+                    <xsl:text>\ </xsl:text>
+                </xsl:if>
             </xsl:when>
             <xsl:otherwise>
                 <xsl:text>\OSCondEndBlock{}</xsl:text>
@@ -4000,11 +4026,16 @@ end
         </xsl:call-template>
         <xsl:text>}</xsl:text>
         <xsl:if test="$standalone and $command = 'instructionnote'"><xsl:text>}</xsl:text></xsl:if>
-        <!-- Separate a run-in label from a following word even when that
-             word is wrapped in an inline element without source whitespace. -->
-        <xsl:if test="$within and not($crosses) and not(@f:parallel-block = 'true')
-                      and matches(string(following-sibling::node()[string(.) ne ''][1]),
-                                  '^[\p{L}\p{N}\p{Ps}]')">
+        <!-- Run-in rubrics need a word boundary before an inline scope's
+             opening bracket as well as before ordinary prayer words. A note
+             inside j:conditional is emitted immediately before that bracket. -->
+        <xsl:if test="$command = 'instructionnote' and
+            (@f:needs-space-after = 'true' or
+             ($within and not($crosses) and not(@f:parallel-block = 'true')
+              and matches(string(following-sibling::node()[string(.) ne ''][1]),
+                                  '^[\p{L}\p{N}\p{Ps}]')) or
+             (parent::j:conditional[f:is-inline-conditional(.)]
+              and not(matches(string(.), '\s$'))))">
             <xsl:text>\ </xsl:text>
         </xsl:if>
         </xsl:if>
@@ -4141,7 +4172,10 @@ end
              template), so its notes are footnotes whatever the placement. -->
         <xsl:value-of select="if ($notes-placement = 'endnote' and not(ancestor::tei:back[@p:colophon]))
                               then 'Bendnote' else 'Bfootnote'"/>
-        <xsl:text>{\OSFootnotemark{</xsl:text>
+        <xsl:variable name="rtl" select="f:is-rtl-lang(string((ancestor-or-self::*[@xml:lang][1])/@xml:lang))"/>
+        <xsl:text>{\OSNoteDirection{</xsl:text>
+        <xsl:value-of select="if ($rtl) then 'TRT' else 'TLT'"/>
+        <xsl:text>}\OSFootnotemark{</xsl:text>
         <xsl:value-of select="f:note-mark($serial)"/>
         <xsl:text>}\notenote{</xsl:text>
         <xsl:call-template name="note-content"/>
diff --git a/opensiddur/exporter/tex/typography_tex.py b/opensiddur/exporter/tex/typography_tex.py
index 0b974fc..8304b76 100644
--- a/opensiddur/exporter/tex/typography_tex.py
+++ b/opensiddur/exporter/tex/typography_tex.py
@@ -705,7 +705,7 @@ def _note_mark_tex(style: TextStyle, anchor: NoteAnchor, spacing: float) -> list
         # interlinear band and the text it annotates is not respaced — which is
         # what keeps two sides of a parallel text aligned.
         body = (
-            r"\leavevmode\hbox to 0pt{\hss{\textdir TLT\raisebox{1.5ex}"
+            r"\leavevmode\hbox to 0pt{\hss{\textdir TLT\raisebox{\dimexpr\ht\strutbox+0.15ex\relax}"
             r"{\foreignlanguage{english}{\kern0.05em\normalfont"
             + tokens
             + r" #1\kern0.05em}}}\hss}"
diff --git a/opensiddur/tests/exporter/test_keep_together_geometry.py b/opensiddur/tests/exporter/test_keep_together_geometry.py
index 6723d81..639b2bb 100644
--- a/opensiddur/tests/exporter/test_keep_together_geometry.py
+++ b/opensiddur/tests/exporter/test_keep_together_geometry.py
@@ -256,8 +256,9 @@ class _KeepTogether:
     def test_the_rubrics_stand_on_lines_of_their_own(self):
         # A rubric run in with its text is part of a line of text; only one on lines of
         # its own can be parted from what it introduces.
-        self.assertNotIn(r"\instructionnote{", self.tex)
-        self.assertIn(r"\OSInstructionBlock{", self.tex)
+        body = self.tex.split(r"\begin{document}", 1)[1]
+        self.assertNotRegex(body, r"\\instructionnote\{(?!\\pstart)")
+        self.assertRegex(body, r"\\(?:OSInstructionBlock\{|instructionnote\{\\pstart)")
 
     def test_no_widows(self):
         self.assertEqual(self._of_kind("widow"), [])

         self.assertIn(

         note = out[out.index(r"\Bfootnote{"):]
         note = note[:note.index(r"\pend")]
         self.assertIn(r"\OSListItem{Alpha}\newline \OSListItem{Beta}", note)
